description: `@bag.tags[0] = ""` writes a position of a tape `invariant (tags.every(…))` reads: refused E-BOOTSTRAP-UNSUPPORTED (INTERIM) rather than written unchecked.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 "When it is checked": every write that changes a field in the read set is checked; until the bootstrap builds the candidate of a position write, the write is refused (fail closed).
